question: Which deterministic in-process glyph reconstruction and row-boundary rule maps both authorized Layout B fixtures to exactly their manifest rows and controls without filename, external-process, or fixture-data dependencies?
context: Blocks DD-INGEST-FORMAT-ADAPTERS and TASK-INGEST-ADAPTER-LAYOUT-B. Sanitized in-process spikes against both owner-authorized Layout B fixtures proved exact transaction-date anchor counts after excluding full statement-period dates and proved the existing format discriminator rejects Layout A. They disproved baseline-only visual lines, fixed coordinate grids, midpoint date bands, nearest monotonic rows, PdfPig content-order text, nearest-neighbour word lines, and Docstrum lines as exact row reconstruction rules: none uniquely reconstructed every description, movement, control, metadata field, and source-evidence span without manifest facts.
